mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_order (errand_order_id, publisher_id, taker_id, type, description, pickup_location, delivery_location, reward, time_limit_hours, images, deadline, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (0, #{publisherId}, #{takerId}, #{type}, #{description}, #{pickupLocation}, #{deliveryLocation}, #{reward}, #{timeLimitHours}, #{images}, #{deadline}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET errand_order_id = id WHERE id = #{id} AND errand_order_id = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT , FROM errand_order e
WHERE e.errand_order_id IN #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'PENDING_REVIEW', deadline = #{deadline}, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE errand_order SET taker_id = #{takerId}, state = 'LOCKED', lock_seq = lock_seq + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND taker_id IS NULL AND deadline > NOW()
UPDATE errand_order SET taker_id = NULL, state = 'PUBLISHED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND taker_id = #{takerId} AND state = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE errand_order SET taker_id = NULL, state = 'PUBLISHED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'LOCKED' AND lock_seq = #{lockSeq}

UPDATE errand_order SET taker_id = NULL, state = 'PUBLISHED', taker_canceled = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND taker_id = #{takerId} AND state = 'CONFIRMED' AND taker_canceled = 0
UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'DISPUTED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PICKED_UP', 'DELIVERED')
UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'DISPUTED'
UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'COMPLETED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'DISPUTED'
UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state IN ('PUBLISHED', 'LOCKED', 'CONFIRMED', 'PICKED_UP') AND deadline <= NOW()
UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'CANCELLED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

UPDATE errand_order SET type = #{type}, description = #{description}, pickup_location = #{pickupLocation}, delivery_location = #{deliveryLocation}, reward = #{reward}, time_limit_hours = #{timeLimitHours}, images = #{images}, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{errandOrderId} AND publisher_id = #{publisherId} AND state = 'DRAFT'

mapper.update: UPDATE errand_order SET state = 'PUBLISHED', update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId} AND state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_order_event (order_id, event_type, from_state, to_state, actor_id, actor_role, reason_type, reason, images, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{eventType}, #{fromState}, #{toState}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole}, #{reasonType}, #{reason}, #{images}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT IGNORE INTO errand_view_history (user_id, errand_order_id, viewed_at) VALUES
(#{userId}, #{orderId}, NOW())
mapper.update: INSERT INTO errand_view_count (errand_order_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO errand_feed_index (errand_order_id, state, feed_time, price, view_count, update_time) SELECT e.errand_order_id, 'PUBLISHED', NOW(), e.reward, 0, NOW() FROM errand_order e WHERE e.errand_order_id = #{orderId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = 'PUBLISHED', update_time = NOW()
UPDATE errand_feed_index SET state = #{state}, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE errand_feed_index SET view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE errand_order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_feed_index (errand_order_id, state, feed_time, price, view_count, update_time) SELECT e.errand_order_id, e.state, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(cr.create_time) FROM content_review cr WHERE cr.target_type = 'ERRAND' AND cr.target_id = e.errand_order_id AND cr.action = 'APPROVE'), e.create_time), e.reward, COALESCE(evc.view_count, 0), NOW() FROM errand_order e LEFT JOIN errand_view_count evc ON evc.errand_order_id = e.errand_order_id WHERE e.state = 'PUBLISHED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_review cr2 WHERE cr2.target_type = 'ERRAND' AND cr2.target_id = e.errand_order_id AND cr2.action = 'APPROVE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM errand_view_count WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM errand_view_history h WHERE h.errand_order_id = errand_view_count.errand_order_id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO errand_view_count (errand_order_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT h.errand_order_id, COUNT(*), NOW(), NOW() FROM errand_view_history h GROUP BY h.errand_order_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), update_time = NOW()
